specification.name: Quarterly claims
specification.about: The claims each program administrator files every quarter (and the statewide claims each statewide program's lead files), compiled into the claim year to date.

version.name: Legacy CEDARS claims, 2023-2026
version.summary: The layout of legacy CEDARS' record-level claims download for claim years 2023 to 2026. Recorded from the download's header as CEDARS publishes it, for the years imported from it: those years were filed and checked in legacy CEDARS, so no filing is checked against this version and it is never changed.

file_format.files: one comma-delimited file per table, in a .zip

tables.name: Claims
tables.guidance: The claims download: one row per measure record, with its program, claim, link IDs, dates, flags and CEDARS' CET outputs. Also the layout of the statewide claims CEDARS publishes unallocated.
